title: Tender Released for Khelo India Youth Games 2026
indian_angle: This tender is for a major multi-sport event in India, providing opportunities for young Indian badminton talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released a tender for the upcoming Khelo India Youth Games 2026, signaling preparations for the national event.

title: Eligibility List Out for Junior National Badminton Championships
indian_angle: This announcement is crucial for young Indian players aspiring to compete in one of the most significant junior national events.
summary: The eligibility list for the 49th Junior National Badminton Championships 2026, scheduled in Sikkim from November 14-21, has been officially released.

title: Junior World Championships 2026 National Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's top junior players to perform at the highest level in the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing Indian players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Concludes in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The successful completion of this course enhances the coaching standards across India, directly benefiting aspiring Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course across two centers, NCE Guwahati and Raipur, from September 14-23, 2026.

title: Indian Team Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships Begins
indian_angle: This coaching camp is crucial for developing young Indian talent and preparing them for competitive play at the Asian junior level.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact how junior badminton matches are played and strategized across all Indian domestic tournaments.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
